ओह हो! क्या बॉलीवुड की इस हसीना ने अपने प्यार पर लगा दी है मुहर? 😍

कृति सेनन ने अपने इंस्टाग्राम स्टोरी पर रूमर्ड बॉयफ्रेंड कबीर बहिया की एक वेकेशन की तस्वीर शेयर करके उन्हें जन्मदिन की बधाई दी है। 📸

इस तस्वीर के साथ कृति ने लिखा, “Happy Birthday cutie,” और साथ में एक दिल और नजर बट्टू वाला इमोजी भी लगाया है। ❤️

इससे पहले दिवाली पर भी कृति ने एक पोस्ट शेयर किया था जिसमें वह कबीर और दोस्तों के साथ नजर आई थीं, और कैप्शन में लिखा था कि यह उनके साल का सबसे पसंदीदा समय है। ✨

Times Now को दिए एक पुराने इंटरव्यू में कृति ने कहा था कि वह शादी होने तक अपनी पर्सनल लाइफ के बारे में बात नहीं करना चाहतीं। 💍

आपको क्या लगता है, कृति और कबीर जल्द ही अपने रिश्ते का ऑफिशियल ऐलान करेंगे या नहीं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Kriti Sanon shares vacation photo of rumoured boyfriend Kabir Bahia on his birthday, calls him ‘cutie’
ctx.summary: Kriti Sanon shared a beachside photo of Kabir Bahia on Instagram Stories, wishing him a happy birthday.
ctx.text:
Kriti Sanon has often spoken about preferring to keep her personal life away from the spotlight. While the actor chooses how much she wants to share publicly, she occasionally gives fans a glimpse into her life through social media. She recently took to Instagram to wish her rumoured boyfriend, Kabir Bahia , on his birthday.
Kriti shared a playful picture of Kabir on her Instagram Story to wish him on his birthday. The candid photograph showed him on what appeared to be a beach vacation. Sharing the picture, Kriti wrote, “Happy Birthday cutie,” accompanied by a heart and an evil-eye emoji.
Before this, Kriti had shared glimpses of her Diwali celebrations with family and friends. The carousel featured pictures of the actor celebrating the festival with Kabir and posing for photographs together. Wishing her fans on the occasion, Kriti wrote in the caption, “My favvvv time of the year with some of my fav ppl Happy Diwali everyone.”
During an earlier interaction with Times Now, Kriti was asked about her rumoured relationship with Kabir.
Addressing the same, she said, “I would not want to talk about my personal life at least till I am married. The day I get marriedn. I will talk about it. There are some things that are just for me and my close people and between us, I say everything.”
Kabir Bahia is a UK-based businessman and entrepreneur. He is the founder and managing director of Worldwide Aviation and Tourism Limited, a company he established in 2020 that specialises in airline representation services. He is also the son of Kuljinder Bahia, who owns the UK-based travel company Southall Travel.
Kriti and Kabir have been spotted together at several social gatherings and family occasions over the past couple of years. Kabir's prominent presence at Kriti's sister Nupur Sanon's wedding didn't go unnoticed by fans. However, Kriti and Kabir have not officially confirmed that they are dating.
On the professional front, Kriti was last seen in Cocktail 2, which also stars Shahid Kapoor and Rashmika Mandanna. The romantic drama, directed by Homi Adajania, released in theatres on June 19, 2026. She also featured in Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, which arrived in cinemas earlier that month, on June 5.
Looking ahead, Kriti is set to headline an untitled horror film backed by Maddock Films. The project will mark her first outing in the pure horror genre and her ninth collaboration with the production house.
Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
